subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this grouped action refresh be accepted after representative final-head workflow runs, or split by security, release, and agent trust domain for narrower validation?
rationale: The diff has no concrete correctness defect, but it replaces third-party code across several privileged workflow boundaries whose acceptable validation depth is an owner decision.

options.title: Validate and approve together
options.body: Run or inspect representative CodeQL, Docker, token-minting, and Codex-agent workflows on the exact head, then approve the grouped update if they succeed.

options.title: Split by trust domain
options.body: Separate security scanning, Docker publishing, repository automation, and Codex Action updates when owners cannot confidently validate the grouped change.

recommendation.title: Validate and approve together
recommendation.body: Run or inspect representative CodeQL, Docker, token-minting, and Codex-agent workflows on the exact head, then approve the grouped update if they succeed.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad decision crosses ClawSweeper, Docker release, and repository automation surfaces connected to his recent work.
